messages:
maya: Heads-up — AcmeHealth just flagged increased 503s on /v1/generate for their Dedicated pool starting ~02:10 PDT. CS says this looks like it could push them over their SLA if it keeps up during tomorrow's scheduled batch. Need quick owners + a short remediation plan.
adrian: I'll own incident coordination. @samira @jake can you grab logs and recent deploys? any infra changes in the last 24h?
samira: We changed kernel selection heuristics on the runtime yesterday at 23:50 UTC (small perf tweak). I rolled a canary but only 10% traffic — will pull logs now to see error patterns.
jake: I can implement a short-term routing fallback to the smaller model variant and add a prefix cache bypass for AcmeHealth. Can push a canary routing rule in ~10m. Will need a quick CR from @adrian for the routing policy.
maya: CS asked whether customer would accept temporary degraded throughput if it prevents 503s. @cs-bot can you confirm?
cs-bot: AcmeHealth PM confirmed via email: temporary degraded qps is acceptable until 10:00 PDT tomorrow, provided we avoid SLA violations. They want an ETA and a follow-up note after fix.
jake: Proposed ephemeral route change (will only affect their dedicated pool):
```
route add acmehealth_fallback {
  match: customer_id == "acmehealth" && path == "/v1/generate"
  action: route_to_model("gpt-small-quant")
  priority: 100
  ttl: 3600 // revert after 1h if no manual change
}
```
I can apply as canary then promote.
adrian: Timeline I can commit to: samira to verify need for rollback or hotfix (15m), jake to deploy fallback canary (25m), promote fallback to 100% (40m) if canary looks good. Root cause hotfix ETA 4h if it's a kernel selection regression; rollback would be faster (~30-45m) if that proves necessary. I'll open a short PR for the routing policy now — pinging @kira for approval on the TTL and priority.
kira: TTL=3600 is fine, priority looks good. I'll review the PR in the next 10. Also recommend adding a short circuit breaker for 503 thresholds so we auto-failover if p50(past 5m) > 1.2s.
samira: Confirmed logs show spike in 5xx from kv-cache miss handling at 02:09 PDT. That points to the kernel selection tweak. I'm preparing a rollback patch; will post patch link in this thread when ready.
adrian: Okay team — action items / owners: samira (rollback/patch), jake (routing canary + promote), kira (PR review), maya/adrian (customer comms). CS will issue customer note after we promote fallback. Please update this thread when each step completes.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: canary-rt-fallback -> 2387654380 (initiated).
maya: Thanks. CS will send an interim note once fallback is promoted. Please drop a one-line status here when done so I can close the loop with AcmeHealth. :thumbsup:
